## Common Mistakes

- Shins not being vertical
- Rounding the back
- Dropping down too quickly into the squat (not slow and controlled)

## Ascent

1. Drive feet into the floor
2. Simultaneously raise hips and shoulders
3. Push shoulders slightly back into the bar so chest remains facing outward (-48)
4. Continue extending hips and knees
5. Maintain proper head and eye position
6. Stand erect and back into the start position

## Common Mistakes

- Bouncing out of the bottom of the squat
- Raising hips too quickly out of the bottom of the squat
- Allowing the weight to shift to the toes
